reported_error: StageError: Channel 2 left its bypassed staging slot
cleanup_interpretation: the old runner sent wire channel 2 after assignment; because the assignment had exchanged the processing map, this does not prove physical Channel 2 was bypassed

offline_resolution.cause: the runner incorrectly assumed active slot indexes stay attached to their processing-chain indexes
offline_resolution.firmware_behavior: when Pari/12 changes the processing permutation, firmware 1.28 replays Pari/16 for both chains with the two active slot indexes exchanged
offline_resolution.meaning: after Assign Voice FX = Ch2, physical Input 2 and its slot-2/3 family are served through processing chain 1
offline_resolution.correct_target_after_assignment: wire channel 1 / processing chain 1, physical Channel 2, global slot 3
